rows.grounds: compound naming the root Kaula attainment of siddhis

items.question: What is identified as the root Kaula attainment of the eight siddhis?
premises: The goddess is addressed as fair-faced.
items.inference: The verse names mūlakaula as the attainment of the eight siddhis.
uncertainties: Exact sandhi and compound boundaries are editorial.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
